definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a noun to name an organized exhibition or art/cultural show. Used widely in titles of museum, gallery, and trade-show events.

examples.japanese: {絵画|かいが}{展|てん}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a painting exhibition.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{写真|しゃしん}{家|か}の{回顧|かいこ}{展|てん}が{来月|らいげつ}{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: A retrospective exhibition by a famous photographer will be held next month.

notes:
A shortened form of {展覧|てんらん}{会|かい} (exhibition) used as a noun suffix. Most common in art, photography, and design contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {個|こ}{展|てん}: solo exhibition
- {絵画|かいが}{展|てん}: painting exhibition
- {写真|しゃしん}{展|てん}: photo exhibition
- {回顧|かいこ}{展|てん}: retrospective exhibition
- {企画|きかく}{展|てん}: special (themed) exhibition
- {美術|びじゅつ}{展|てん}: art exhibition

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{展|てん}を{開|ひら}く / {開催|かいさい}する: to hold an exhibition
- 〜{展|てん}に{行|い}く: to go to an exhibition
